name: Houou no Ruka
source:
Earth Age: 23 years old.
Special Trait: Turban
Element: Dark
Abilities: Can control darkness and light
Special Skill: He can read minds with his fingertips

He's taciturn, but inside he's emotional.
The type with a strong will who always follows through on his beliefs.
He's kind and often worries about others more than himself.
